newsitem.title: USA: US Airways expands lawsuit against British Airways.
newsitem.headline: US Airways expands lawsuit against British Airways.

text.p: US Airways said on Wednesday it has expanded its lawsuit against British Airways, to include alleged breach of fiduciary duty by BA's representatives on the US Airways board.
In addition, US Airways said it amended its initial antitrust and contract allegations in the suit filed with a federal court in New York.
US Airways said it expanded its lawsuit based upon information gathered in the pre-trial discovery process.

It said the amended complaint has been filed under seal, in accordance with the rules of the court, because it contains references to documents that British Airways and American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp, claim contain confidential information.
US Airways, then called USAir, filed suit in July, 1996, alleging that British Airways' alliance with American Airlines violated terms of a similar alliance it signed with British Airways in 1993.
The suit also alleged that both British Airways and American Airlines violated U.S. antitrust laws that prohibit conduct that harms competition.
In addition, US Airways also alleged that British Airways failed to act in good faith and breached its fiduciary duty to US Airways as a joint venture partner.
